result.summary: The street provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a signalized intersection, but the crosswalk markings are severely faded and lack high-visibility patterns. While flexible bollards are used for center-line delineation, the absence of dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands increases exposure for people crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side at the traffic light pole

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense trees on the left side of the image may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the view of oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style high-visibility pavement markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals, with flexible bollards creating a curb extension on the left side to reduce crossing distance. While sidewalks are present and in good condition, the lack of a median refuge and visible pedestrian-specific signals increases exposure for those crossing near the school.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate the walk/don't walk phases at this signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: At the traffic light mast arms

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross both lanes of traffic without a median refuge island to provide a mid-point safety zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the zebra crosswalk

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add signal heads that show the remaining time to cross, improving predictability and safety for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Construct a Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Provide a physical barrier in the center of the road to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Hardened Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace the flexible bollards with permanent concrete curb extensions to further reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks, but lacks advanced safety features like refuge islands or visible pedestrian signals. The presence of a large school bus highlights potential sightline issues and the need for traffic calming in an area that appears to serve institutional land uses.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The large school bus in the intersection creates a significant blind spot for other motorists regarding pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are showing signs of wear, which reduces their visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Upgrades
interventions.description: Refresh crosswalk markings with high-visibility thermoplastic ladder patterns to improve driver compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles at the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information to pedestrians about remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks and traffic signals, supplemented by flexible delineators to narrow the roadway. Despite these features, the absence of visible pedestrian signals and the wide crossing distance remain areas for improvement.

hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-street refuge island.
